description: Born in Bhubaneswar, Odisha at 10:43 IST. Aries Lagna, Moon in Aquarius (Purva Bhadrapada Pada 3), Sun in Capricorn (Shravana Pada 4).
Mother enrolled native in painting classes; native excelled and won multiple awards in childhood painting competitions. Creative visual skill established early.
Severe headaches onset around 1995 (age 11). Became a defining health motif of early life; screen time catalyzed headaches.
Stammering onset in childhood (~1995). Three-phase arc: Phase 1 (childhood ~1995-2006): significant stammering. Phase 2 (~2007-2024): substantially overcame it. Phase 3 (~2025-present): resurfaced.
Relationship #1 started (age 14). This childhood girlfriend later became native's wife (married 2013-12-11). Total duration as relationship pre-marriage ~15 years.

Father held late-night spiritual dialogues; native joined in limited capacity during teens (~1997-2001). Father's approach intermingled Hinduism and spirituality — became the native's foundational spiritual orientation.

Joined Aptech computer education course post-10th board exams (~2000, age 16). Was among the brighter students but could not sit certification exam — program required graduate minimum qualification; native was pre-graduate.
Began IIT preparation around March 2001 (age 17, during 12th standard). Continued intensive preparation through June 2003.
Inherited vertigo/head reeling reached peak debilitation during engineering competitive exam preparation (~2001-2004). Bouts were debilitating and directly impacted academic performance.
Father instructed native (age ~18-19) to perform Shani Puja nightly. Native read Shani Shtotram every night for approximately 7-10 years. First formal sustained sadhana practice.
IIT preparation phase ended (June 2003). Transitioned to engineering admission at SRM Chennai.
Relationship #2 started (Jan 2004, 3-year duration → ended ~Jan 2007). During engineering years at SRM Chennai (age 19-20). Concurrent with primary long-term relationship R#1. Entirely pre-marriage.

Selected by SRM Engineering College as one of 4-5 students for 1-year exchange at Carnegie Mellon University. Could not accept due to health issues and financial constraints. Native experienced 'deja vu' when CMU reappeared as Tepper MBA sponsorship in 2021.
Joined Cognizant — first corporate IT job. Tenure exactly one year.
Engineering (B.Tech) completed at SRM Chennai, around June 2007.
Right knee arthroscopy (minor surgery).

Sleep disorder onset arising from medical negligence during the knee arthroscopy. Negligence caused a breathlessness problem which triggered a chronic sleep disorder. Persisted ~18 years until resolved 2025-2026.
Exited Cognizant exactly 1 year after joining. Returned to Bhubaneswar to re-attempt IIT preparation.
Paternal grandfather passed away (June or July 2009). Described by native as 'academic mentor' — a major emotional setback.
Father received a large sum from selling real estate (around 2010). Family-level financial windfall.
Began regular devotion to Maa Ugratara at the Ugratara Shakti pitha near Bhubaneswar (~15 years running as of 2026). A tantric Shakti form. Native's longest-sustained single devata relationship.
First international travel — Thailand trip, December 2010.
Secured admission to XIMB (Xavier Institute of Management, Bhubaneswar) MBA program (January 2011).
Formally enrolled at XIMB MBA (June 2011). Beginning of highly fulfilling 2-year program.
Elected President of the International Relations Committee (IRC) at XIMB. Had opportunity to stand for General Secretary but declined.
Modeling at XIMB (September 2012).
Relationship #3 started (October 2012, 10-year duration → ended ~October 2022). Concurrent with primary long-term relationship R#1 through marriage year.
Graduated from XIMB MBA (March 2013).
Formally joined Mahindra Retail (May 2013) following XIMB placement and internship. Beginning of 10-year Mahindra Group tenure.
Father's kidney disease began in 2013. This became a 5-year illness culminating in his passing on 2018-11-28.
Married childhood girlfriend (R#1, dating since 1998-02-16). Marriage duration before separation: ~12 years.
In early thirties (~2014-2016), native began gravitating toward Mahadev/Shiva. This deepened over the following decade to daily abhisheka. Concurrent with Ugratara devotion.
Mahindra Retail company 'crashed'; triggered career stress and job search. Decision to switch to Tech Mahindra crystallized during this period.
Switched from Mahindra Retail to Tech Mahindra (March 2017). Within-Mahindra-Group move; upgraded platform. Leads to US deputation in 2019.
Father passed away on 28 November 2018, culminating 18-year kidney disease journey. Native ran between Hyderabad and Bhubaneswar during final hospital phase.
Moved to the United States on Tech Mahindra work deputation (May 2019). 4-year stint; returned to India May 2023.
Health episode with jitters and sweating — panic/anxiety episode in January 2021. Native was in US stint, roughly 1 year before twins' birth.

Selected as one of the top employees across the Mahindra Group and sponsored for 1-year Executive MBA at Tepper School of Business, Carnegie Mellon University. Native experienced this as a 'deja vu' of the 2004 CMU opportunity.

A second sand quarry was acquired and attempted for operationalisation ~2021-2022 but could not be made operational due to public hearing requirements. Multiple attempts to resolve unsuccessful over ~4-5 years until April 2026.
Twin daughters born on 3 January 2022. Native's only children.

A serious affair during the CMU Tepper Executive MBA period (2022-2023). This affair generated significant marital tension and is cited by native as a direct contributing cause of the current marital separation.
Relationship #3 ended (approximately October 2022, 10-year duration from start). Coincides with Mercury-Jupiter AD transition and start of '2022-2024 mix' period.
Returned to India from United States (May 2023) after 4-year stint. Concurrent with US job loss. Marks pivotal transition from salaried corporate employment to entrepreneurship.
Tepper School of Business (Carnegie Mellon University) Executive MBA completed (June 2023). Sponsored by Tech Mahindra. Recognized as top performer.
Founded Marsys Group (July 2023). Spans mining, AI, technology, and exports (notably with Russia). Strategic focus: system building, automation, strategic patience.
Launched Kotadwara (riverbed sand) mining operation at Bhanti on 16 February 2024. Major concrete step in Marsys Group's mining vertical.
From ~2024: daily pouring of water on shivalinga (abhisheka); independent yajna execution; systematic panchang study. Highest concentration of new spiritual practices in native's life.
Major deception / scam event (May 2025). Native was deceived / defrauded in a significant matter.
Native established a personal yantra mandala in his bedroom — a permanent ritual space. Prayers offered almost daily. Represents formalization of private ritual life begun ~2024.
Spiritual shift toward Lord Vishnu / Lord Venkateshwara Balaji of Tirupati. Occurred 'naturally'; continues alongside long-term Maa Ugratara and Mahadev devotions.

Chronic sleep disorder (onset 2007, ~18 years) resolved via Lemborexant (brand name: Dayvigo), discovered through an astrology consultation. First medication to work without debilitating drowsiness side effects.
First major Marsys business contract (Marsys Technology — July 2025). Windfall-class revenue event; first concrete large-scale win for the business.
Native began praying intensely to the tantric form of Mahalakshmi — Ma Kamlatmika (one of the Dasha Mahavidyas). Coincides with financial recovery and business intensification.

Between January and February 2026, native experienced a marked and sustained shift to focused, one-pointed attention directed entirely at business. Long-standing distractions described as 'wiped out'.
Marsys Technology (IT company co-founded with a MasterCard executive) wrapped up its primary project on 20 March 2026 with 'enormous profits'. Revenue generated steadily from 2023 through 2026.
Public hearing for the second sand quarry successfully closed on 8 April 2026, clearing the primary regulatory obstacle after ~4-5 years. Quarry expected to become operational by late October 2026.
Separated from wife (R#1, married Dec 11, 2013). Stable arrangement. Currently improving per native's own characterization.
